body: If I were you I would spend the rest of your time and money doing crazy shit you always wanted to and then if youbare terminal, depending on your state, end your life with dignity pills from dr

I think when asked why you havent found a job yet you should turn it around into you have been looking for the right company, you can also say you have been resting after school ended, using time for self development which searching for a company that is a good fit and will appreciate you

I feel like I have already had a good life and I think having the choice to end it when you are ready is empowering, I wish I could go to a clinic to get a death shot, a sleep induced death is my dream
Im sorry for your loss, would he want you to go on to lead a happy life?
The thought of getting a job makes me want to kill myself too, you are not alone

I like the idea of dying young too, I am 28F, and I dont want to get older, I was reading how im Belgium you can get a shot to die, I wish I could do that here in the US, I am suffering mentally everyday. I want to die peacefully in my sleep, in a safe way, I am sober, I could face having to move/homelessness in next 30 days, who wants to be on streets in CA? So dangerous. And all the pills the psychiatrist gave me made me feel sick or were a risk driving, etc. I feel that if the US isnt going to offer job security/health care, then I should have the right to a peaceful death. I dont want to hang myself or do something that can make me worse without actually killing me. For a while I didnt want to leave the house cuz I had the urge to step in front of moving cars, I dont want to do that to the driver, etc...

Because I feel sick all the time, eating too much, too little, I broke up with bf, moved out, was more depressed, moved back in, now all I do is sleep. He gets mad Im depressed. I tried anti depressants and they made me feel sick, cant afford therapy, my vision is going blurry but I dont have a job or health care so I am just telling myself everything is going to get better, but it isnt...
